title: Miniscope DAQ user config
description: A user config file for the Miniscope DAQ software (v2.x). Extra keys are allowed everywhere: labs keep notes, COMMENT_* entries, and custom directoryStructure tokens in their configs. The software validates configs against this schema at load time but never refuses to run because of a schema warning.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema so editors like VS Code can validate and autocomplete the config.

configVersion.description: Version of the config format this file was written for. Stamped automatically when saving from the in-app editor.

dataDirectory.description: Absolute path to the base directory all data is saved to. Use '/' separators, not '\'.

directoryStructure.description: Defines the recording folder hierarchy under dataDirectory. 'date' and 'time' (any capitalization) become the recording's start date/time; any other entry must name a top-level key in this config whose string value is used as the folder name.

researcherName.description: Saved in the recording's metaData.json; can also be used as a directoryStructure entry.

experimentName.description: Saved in the recording's metaData.json; can also be used as a directoryStructure entry.

animalName.description: Saved in the recording's metaData.json; can also be used as a directoryStructure entry.

recordLengthInSeconds.description: 0 = record until manually stopped; any positive value stops the recording after that many seconds.

recordLengthinSeconds.description: DEPRECATED spelling of recordLengthInSeconds (kept working forever; the corrected spelling is preferred).

experiment.description: Reserved for experiment metadata; currently not interpreted by the software.

devices.description: The Miniscopes and behavior cameras this session uses. At least one device is needed to run.

oneOf.description: Current form: one entry per Miniscope, keyed by a unique device name.
Legacy form: an array of devices, each carrying its own deviceName.
Current form: one entry per behavior camera, keyed by a unique device name.
Legacy form: an array of devices, each carrying its own deviceName.

behaviorTracker.description: DeepLabCut-Live behavior tracking (requires a build with Python support).

pyEnvPath.description: Absolute path to a Python environment that can run DeepLabCut-Live.

modelPath.description: Absolute path to the DLC model to use.

resize.description: Downscales the camera image fed to DLC (0-1) when the CPU/GPU can't keep up.

pCutoffDisplay.description: Minimum p value for pose data to be plotted (all pose data is still recorded).

poseIdxForTraceDisplay.description: Pose indices to plot in the trace display; each entry is an index plus 'w', 'h', or 'wh' (e.g. "3wh").

poseIdxToUse.description: Pose indices whose positions build the occupancy histogram.

type.description: How past poses are drawn over the camera image.

connectedIndices.description: Chains of pose indices to connect with lines.

traceDisplay.description: The scrolling trace window (head orientation, pose traces).

commutator.description: Optional Open Ephys commutator control (github.com/open-ephys/commutator-controller). When enabled, the software drives the commutator over its USB serial port using a Miniscope's live BNO head orientation, so the tether unwinds as the animal turns - no Bonsai needed. Needs a V4_BNO (or newer) Miniscope with headOrientation.enabled true.

enabled.description: Turns the whole commutator feature on/off.

port.description: Serial port the commutator is on, e.g. "COM5" (Windows), "/dev/ttyACM0" (Linux), "/dev/cu.usbmodemXXXX" (macOS). If it can't be opened, the software logs the available ports.

deviceName.description: Which Miniscope's head orientation drives the commutator (its key under devices.miniscopes). Optional: if omitted, the first Miniscope with headOrientation enabled is used.

led.description: Turn the commutator's indicator LED on (default true).

sampleRate.description: How many times per second (Hz) the orientation is sampled to compute a turn command. Default 10.

headstageAxis.description: Direction the tether leaves the headstage, as [x, y, z] in the IMU's reference frame. Default [0, 0, 1]. Negate it (e.g. [0, 0, -1]) if the commutator winds the tether up instead of unwinding it.

commutatorAxis.description: Direction the tether enters the rotating commutator element, as [x, y, z] in the global frame. Default [0, 0, 1] for an upright mount.

fallbackThreshold.description: Advanced: cosine threshold below which the twist estimate uses a fallback near its mathematical pole (headstage and commutator axes nearly opposed). Default -0.9.

fallbackMode.description: Advanced: which rotation to assume at the pole - "global" (orbital motion about the commutator) or "local" (about the headstage tether axis). Default "global".

executableHook.description: Runs an external program when recording starts/stops, usually to synchronize third-party hardware.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the program to execute.

deviceName.description: Only used in the legacy array form; in the current form the object key is the name.

deviceID.description: Which camera this device is, as an index into the OS camera list. Use the software's 'Scan Devices' button to see the current mapping.

videoPlayback.description: Play back a previously recorded session instead of opening a live camera (alternative to deviceID).

compression.description: FOURCC of the codec used for recording (e.g. "MJPG", "FFV1", "GREY"). Must be supported by the host; the software checks at load.

framesPerFile.description: Recordings roll over to a new .avi file after this many frames.

ROI.description: Region of interest to record, in camera pixels.

frameRate.description: Frame rate; V4 uses strings like "20FPS".

led0.description: Excitation LED power at startup, in the led0 slider's units (0-100 by default; 0-255 with led0FineSteps).

led0FineSteps.description: When true, the led0 slider runs 0-255 and addresses the LED driver's 255 hardware steps individually instead of 0-100%, giving 2.55x finer steps - useful for very dim illumination. Both mappings span the same brightness range. Off by default: existing configs keep their exact LED output.

led1.description: Second excitation LED power at startup on dual-color scopes (Miniscope_V4_2C_Manual), in the led1 slider's units (0-100 by default; 0-255 with led1FineSteps). Ignored by single-LED devices.

led1FineSteps.description: The led1 equivalent of led0FineSteps: runs the second LED's slider 0-255 over the driver's individual hardware steps instead of 0-100%.

optoPeriod.description: Optogenetic stimulation period in seconds, burst-start to burst-start. Only applies to scopes whose catalog entry declares it; no shipped entry does yet. 0 disables stimulation and is the default; both optoPeriod and optoDuration must be non-zero before any stimulation light is emitted.

optoDuration.description: Length of each optogenetic burst in camera frames. Only applies to scopes whose catalog entry declares it; no shipped entry does yet. 0 disables stimulation and is the default.

lut.description: Display colormap toggled by the window's LUT switch.

headOrientation.description: BNO head-orientation streaming (V4 with BNO only).

plotTrace.description: Which angles to plot in the trace display: roll, pitch, yaw.

gain.description: Sensor gain; a MiniCAM uses "1X"/"8X"/"16X"/"32X". Ignored by plain webcams.

frameRate.description: Frame rate; a MiniCAM uses strings like "30FPS". Ignored by plain webcams.

led0.description: Illumination LED power at startup, 0-100. Applies to a MiniCAM (which is on Miniscope DAQ hardware); plain webcams have no LED.
